concept_options.title: What If You Doubled Your Money Every Day?
concept_options.hook: Day thirty-one at Mangesh bhaiya's chai stall: you hold up your phone and the balance runs off the screen, across the counter. A month ago you couldn't pay for that glass.
concept_options.visual_approach: the library's chai stall at night: you large at the left, grinning, the phone held out, its balance (1073741824) spilling off the screen as split-flap digit tiles over the counter; Mangesh bhaiya behind the counter holding out a tiny glass, shocked. Three thumbnail candidates a, b, c differ in the tag (DAY 31., NO BRAKES., EVERYTHING.)
concept_options.why_this_works: The topic title from the 2026-11-11 slate (f-money-doubles, 90/100, ranked 1st); the owner's pick; pairs with thumbnail a (DAY 31.)
